channel.title: Jifunze.ai
channel.description: Practical career, income and AI skills for job seekers, students and new freelancers in Kenya and other emerging markets.

item.title: Your CV never reached a human
item.description: Software reads your CV before any human does. Mirror the advert wording, keep every fact true.

item.title: Delete two words from your CV
item.description: Responsible for says nothing. What you did, plus the number, plus what it changed.

item.title: Your CV objective is wasting space
item.description: Swap the objective for three lines: who you are, one proof with a number, the role you want.

item.title: Tailor any CV in four minutes
item.description: Three edits tailor a CV in four minutes: reorder, mirror the wording, cut the rest.

item.title: Rehearse your interview free tonight
item.description: Free interview rehearsal: one question at a time, follow-ups on vague answers, then your three weakest.

item.title: Never say the first salary number
item.description: Do not name the first number. Ask what band is budgeted, then offer a range you would accept.

item.title: Know the questions before the interview
item.description: Paste the advert into an AI, ask for the 15 likely questions and what each one really tests.

item.title: Turn I want to learn into a plan
item.description: One prompt turns I want to learn X into a 30-day plan with something to show at the end.

item.title: Cover letters take six minutes now
item.description: Three paragraphs: why this company, one proof with a number, and your first three months.

item.title: Stop selling design. Sell one task.
item.description: Narrow beats broad on freelance platforms. Search one specific task and check the competition.

item.title: Build a portfolio with zero clients
item.description: No clients yet? Fix one real local problem, label it self-initiated, write the case study.

item.title: Unreliable power? Choose async work.
item.description: Async work survives power cuts: deadlines not live calls, work offline, finish a day early.

item.title: The follow-up almost nobody sends
item.description: Seven days after applying, send three sentences: what you applied for, one new thing, a short close.

item.title: No experience means nobody paid you
item.description: No experience usually means nobody paid you. Your project, your team, the family business all count.

item.title: Spot a fake job in one minute
item.description: Fake job advert signs: upfront fees, WhatsApp-only interviews, personal email domains, no real company.

item.title: Plan the three months after graduation
item.description: The three months after graduation, planned: master CV, twenty tailored applications, then earn online.
